description: This dataset describes accumulated water rights granted in Chile’s Antofagasta Region from 1905 through 2018. Francisco Mayol and collaborators review National Water Agency records for 1,047 rights and calculate annual cumulative allocations for the Loa River and Salar de Atacama basins. The published Excel workbook separates sixteen variables by water source and use, with flows expressed in litres per second and an accompanying metadata sheet. Current Mendeley version 3 is free under CC BY 4.0; the article cites version 2. Rights represent legal allocation, not observed abstraction, delivered supply or renewable availability. Historical register corrections and aggregation also limit inference about individual users. A reviewer-assessed use is setting institutional constraints or examining allocation pathways in water-demand simulations. platform-sei-weap-water-evaluation-and-adaptation-planning is a related water-allocation tool, but basin configurations and actual withdrawals would need separate sources. No spreadsheet formulas, legal records or simulated allocation outcomes were checked.
name: Antofagasta accumulated water-right allocations, 1905–2018
